$comment: Machine-readable geometry contract for the Nissan GTR Auto POS. Derived by measurement from the owner-approved benchmark. Ratios are normative; dp values are the canonical expanded frame. Rpx values are provenance, NOT implementation targets.

source.caveat: JPEG. Colour samples carry compression error of a few units and edges are soft. Colour tokens below are provisional until resampled from a lossless export; geometry ratios are unaffected at this precision.

canonicalFrame.$comment: The benchmark composition snaps to an 8dp grid at this frame. This is the reference for the Expanded window class, not a fixed app size.

zones.$comment: ratio is normative and drives layout at every width. dp is the value at canonicalFrame. minDp/maxDp clamp the ratio.

bands.$comment: Vertical rhythm of the discovery canvas at canonicalFrame.

gridRules.$comment: How item counts are chosen per row. Counts are DERIVED, never hardcoded.

colorSamples.$comment: Provisional. Measured 6x6 patch averages from the lossy source. Resample from lossless before Phase 2 freeze. Any value adopted must be added to packages/ui/brand-tokens.json, never defined only here.

navBackground.note: cool charcoal; B exceeds R by 9 — benchmark sampling confirms a mild blue bias, resolving the Rev 1.3 conditional

canvas.note: COOL grey, within JPEG error of the token the POS already renders through ShopTheme -> GtrTheme. Confirms the existing palette; the Rev 1.3 name 'CanvasWarm' was wrong but the colour was already right.

brandRed.note: within JPEG error of the existing brand token — adopt the token, do not adopt the sample

tolerances.$comment: Rev 1.4 certifies RATIO and STRUCTURE, not absolute pixels. Rev 1.3's +/-2 Rpx pixel gate is withdrawn; see blueprint section 10.

nonNormative.$comment: Present in the benchmark but explicitly NOT authoritative. See blueprint section 2.
nonNormative.currency: KSh — benchmark mock content. Deployment is Zimbabwe: USD / ZiG per AGENTS.md multi-currency rule.
nonNormative.taxRate: VAT (16%) — Kenyan rate in the mock. Real rate comes from backend tax policy; invoices stay tax-agnostic per action-plan exclusions.
copyDefects: 'GNGUINE PARTS' is a typo in the benchmark and must render as 'GENUINE PARTS'
nonNormative.helperCopy: 'Add Customer (Optional)' — parenthetical helper copy conflicts with the copy rules; resolved to 'Add Customer' (delta D-008).
nonNormative.navigation: 'Reports' appears in the benchmark rail and is replaced by 'EPC Browse' (delta D-001).
